svg.aria-label: Two-stage lock: HBr adds to an alkene
svg.title: Two-stage lock: HBr adds to an alkene
svg.desc: Key first, bolt second. Hover to pause.
svg.text: Two-stage lock: HBr adds to an alkene
Key first, bolt second. Hover to pause.

g.text: Propene · C=C holds a π pair
H⁺ key and Br⁻ bolt wait on the lock
Stage 1 · π pair turns the H⁺ key
H goes to C1 (2 H): Markovnikov
Carbocation on C2 · flat, empty p
Stage 2 · Br⁻ bolt from the TOP
the flat cation takes it: C–Br bond
either face fits a flat cation
H on the C with more H, Br on the other
